title: Can You Solve This Body Mystery?

creative.hook: Two shape-and-function clues challenge children to identify one digestive organ before its animated close-up appears.
creative.learningGoal: Recognize the stomach as a J-shaped muscular pouch that churns food with digestive juices.
creative.signatureMoment: A large original stomach close-up bubbles and churns when the mystery answer is revealed.

researchSources.title: Your Digestive System & How it Works — National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases

clues: I am a stretchy, J-shaped pouch.
I churn food with digestive juices.
funFact: Your stomach slowly sends mixed food into the small intestine.

visual.alt: A playful close-up of the stomach churning food with digestive juices
visual.answerHint: A J-shaped pouch that churns food
